categories.main_business_segments: The company operates as a full-domain e-commerce service provider and new consumer brand accelerator. Main business segments include brand online management services, brand online marketing services, online distribution, and content e-commerce services. The company provides comprehensive services covering brand image building, product design, integrated marketing, data analysis, visual design, online brand operations, precision advertising, CRM management, customer service, and warehousing/logistics across multiple platforms including Tmall, JD.com, Vipshop, Pinduoduo, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and WeChat mini-programs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs data-driven and content-driven operational methods with emphasis on standardized processes using Six Sigma lean management methodology. Core technologies include automated tools for operational efficiency, business intelligence platforms for data analysis, automated financial settlement systems, multi-platform automation toolkits, and risk control systems. The company has developed proprietary methods for new product selection, trend forecasting, and viral product creation across different product categories and price points.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are brand companies across multiple categories including cosmetics, fast-moving consumer goods, health supplements, and consumer durables. The company serves both established brands and emerging growth brands. Major end markets include Tmall, JD.com, Vipshop, Pinduoduo, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and other e-commerce platforms. The company also operates in offline channels including Sam's Club, Costco, Hema Fresh, Ole, City Super, and traditional supermarkets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in mainland China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has established regional operations in Lishui, Guangzhou, Beijing, Shanghai, Ningbo, and Nanjing. The company also maintains international operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Japan. Domestic operations account for approximately 83.27% of revenue while international operations account for 16.73%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the e-commerce supply chain. For brand online management services, the company acts as an authorized operator managing brand flagship stores on third-party platforms. For brand online marketing services, the company purchases inventory from brands and sells directly to consumers. For online distribution, the company purchases from brands and distributes to other B2C platforms and sellers. The company also operates as a general distributor for certain brands in both online and offline channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing operational efficiency, delivering customer value, and managing risks. R&D focuses on automation and digitalization capabilities including automated financial settlement systems, multi-platform automation tools, data intelligence systems, and risk control platforms. The company is investing in digital transformation services for brands, cross-platform marketing integration, and expansion into emerging channels like content e-commerce. Innovation themes emphasize design-driven commercial value and brand digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple models: (1) Brand online management services - charging service fees based on sales performance or agreed service amounts; (2) Brand online marketing services - earning margins from the difference between sales revenue and marketing costs including inventory procurement; (3) Online distribution - earning margins from the difference between sales revenue and procurement costs; (4) Content e-commerce services - charging service fees and sales commissions based on performance. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods or services are delivered.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading full-domain e-commerce service provider in China. Major competitors include Baozun E-commerce (HK:09991, US:BZUN), Liren Lizhuang (SH:605136), Ruoyu Chen (SZ:003010), Kaichun Group (SZ:301001), and Qingmu Group (SZ:301110). The company has achieved industry recognition including Tmall six-star service provider status, Alimama full-domain six-star ecosystem partner, and multiple industry awards. The company emphasizes design-driven innovation and comprehensive service capabilities as competitive differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized e-commerce service provider with 2023 revenue of approximately 1.288 billion yuan, down 16.31% from 2022's 1.539 billion yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 107.93 million yuan in 2023, down 40.05% from 180.04 million yuan in 2022. The company has experienced revenue decline due to strategic adjustments including disposal of subsidiaries, inventory clearance, and business optimization. Total assets were 3.064 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company employs approximately 1,607 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes comprehensive one-stop service capabilities covering brand positioning, product design, marketing strategy, data analysis, and supply chain management. Key differentiators include: (1) Full-domain e-commerce service ability across multiple platforms; (2) Refined operational capabilities using standardized processes and automation; (3) Operational efficiency advantages through proprietary automation tools; (4) Talent development system for rapid capability building; (5) Mastery of e-commerce traffic dynamics and new product launch methodologies; (6) Brand digital transformation service capabilities. The company positions itself as a brand accelerator providing integrated solutions for brand growth and digital transformation.
